title: Analytics cpu
responsibility: Shows sampled local CPU usage while distinguishing machine totals from repository-agent activity.

outputs.name: AnalyticsCpu
outputs.description: Starts a CPU client on mount and stops it on cleanup. Displays pending, available sample or unavailable/retry states; failed samples replace old readings. Shows machine, process-group and tracked-combined percentages, sample metadata and repository-agent process rows. Null percentages stay Not measured. Manual refresh delegates to the client. Explains that history filters do not apply, shared app-server CPU is not attributable per chat, cloud inference is excluded and samples are not automatically published.
